8c5b0378: If X is null, branch based on certain conditions related to DV and D
c876b988: If X is a question mark, branch to QS label. If X starts with ^, do D and branch to ^DIE17
bdbe987a: If X is @, do D and branch to Z^DIE2
510f1b6f: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and the user has a default value defined, set X to the default value and display it if DV does not contain 'D' or 'S'

555ef2b3: Branch to different labels based on conditions related to DV. If DV is not defined, execute code from DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) if it exists. Set Y to X, check for DIC('S') and write value if DB(DQ) is not defined. Go to V label
5ba80d79: Loop through each entry in DU separated by ';'. Set DG to the position of X in the entry. If DG is non-zero, execute DIC('S') if it exists and quit the loop if DG is found
aac7e2c6: If DB(DQ) is not defined, write the portion of the entry starting from DG to the end. Set X to the portion of the entry before the ':'.
02ffca5a: Handles creating/editing cross-references and exiting if the user opts out.
3b5c6252: If the data value is numeric, check if it exceeds the maximum length allowed and exit if it does.
6ebce423: Formats numeric values with fractions/decimals properly, removing trailing zeros and converting to integer if no decimal portion.
1b26edba: Sets the variable X and kills the variable YS.

eff16386: Kills the variables DIC("S") and DLAYGO. If the variable X is defined and not equal to the up-arrow character (^), then it sets the variable DG(DW) to the value of X. If the variable DV contains the letter 'd', it sets the value of ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) to the value of X, and then it goes to the label 'A'.

21bcc7ec: If the ZTQUEUED variable is not defined (i.e., not in a TaskMan job context), it writes a '??' character to the current device. If the variable DB(DQ) is defined, it goes to the label 'Z^DIE17'.
cd1b39e7: Sets the variable X to the string '?BAD'.

5720184b: If the input X is a single character, branch to D (desplaying the field help message). If X is the caret symbol, branch to QQ^DIEQ (validate the response). Otherwise, branch to B (save the response).

8cc436d3: Set the variable D to the current field number DIFLD. Set the element DQ of the DQ array to a string containing the field's label (DLB), its value (DV), its unedited value (DU), word-processing characteristics (DW), and the field's help message text from the MUMPS routine.

0444553b: If the data element DE(DQ) is undefined, branch to O (initialize the array). If the input X is not '@', branch to RD. If the input X is '@' and the field DV does not contain 'R', branch to A. If the input X is '@', set X=Y and branch to N.
05aef346: Set DG to the current value of DV. Set Y to the value of DE(DQ). Set X to the unedited value DU. If DQ(DQ,2) exists, execute the code in DQ(DQ,2). Then branch to RP.
c5446279: Get a pointer to a file entry from a file entry.
a3d8308a: Get a pointer to a sub-entry from an entry in a pointed-to file.
28b5f1e4: Parse the input X for specifiers; S is getting a portion of input X.
26181d73: If the pointer resolution failed, use the default value or quit if the field is required.
93bd476c: Allow only valid input values (internal or external numbers).
6425aaa9: Execute input transform and quit if data passes input check.
1f6a6ce5: Quit if no data was entered.
02b1adc5: Initialize variables for an input template.
3d824ea7: Set up the input template for the SIGNED BY field.
0df6ae73: Set up executable help for SIGNED BY field.

bac5ae5d: Go to input transform.

efaf3059: Returns control to the calling routine or process.
27fb577d: Quit if called at top level.
0280fb35: Execute DIE code to update the file when the data is edited. If the data is unchanged, quit. If the data has changed, process based on the action (add, edit or delete).
033e9de8: If no amendment reason is entered, set the STATUS field to 'TRANSCRIBED' and the AMENDMENT REASON to '@2' (No Change).
8820888d: Execute DIE code when the SIGNED field is edited. If the data is unchanged, quit. If the data has changed, process based on the action.
ff88f901: Set the AMENDMENT REASON to 'SIGNED' when the SIGNED field is edited.
74db42cc: Quit.
229b19ec: Execute DIE code when the VERIFY CODE field is edited. If the data is unchanged, quit. If the data has changed, process based on the action.
3a280d78: If the provider has not signed off on the addendum, set the status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' and store '@2' in Y (which likely indicates the addendum should not be released).
7a706107: Exit/quit the routine.
ac956972: If the DG array is defined, call the F^DIE17 routine to perform file editing actions. Additionally, set various variables used in file editing, such as DQ, DW, DV, DU, DLB, and DIFLD.
63b9bf6c: Set the variable DE(DW) to the value 'C6^DGJXA4', which is likely a routine call or a data value.
eb1d6b5b: Go to the label 'RE' in the routine, which may be used for error handling or other control flow.
080f2efe: If the field .01 (NAME) is defined, set X to its value and DIC to the form DIE. DIE is the input variables global for the FileMan Data Input Utility.
0f081f9b: Set flag DGJREVD to 1 and call the routine PHYDEF^DGJTUTL, which is likely handling the definition of physical fields.
327fa91a: If the field indexed by DQ in the DG array is not null, set X to its value and DIC to DIE.
bc4b87fe: Set flag DGJREVD to 1 and call the routine PHYDEF^DGJTUTL.
ee1bbcc8: Exit the current tag/routine.

960694e9: Set the system variable %DT(0) to the current date/time in external format, set %DT to 'ETX' (external to internal format conversion), call FileMan utility %DT to convert to internal format and store in Y, kill %DT(0), set X to Y and kill X if Y is less than 1 (indicating an invalid date).
8ca8f8fa: Exit the current tag/routine.

1c4cd862: If the DG array is defined with more than 9 nodes, call tag F^DIE17 (possibly looping through multiple entries), then DE, set Y to up-arrow, set DQ=7, call tag X7, if Y is undefined or up-arrow go to A, otherwise set X=Y, DIC(0)='F' (indicating field-type entry), DW=DQ and go to OUT^DIE17.
ecd4333a: If X is defined and is less than the DATE DICTATED field (#.01) of the entry, display an error message, set the .07 node of the DATE DICTATED field to null and set Y to the error code '@7'.
8cd7cbf4: Exit the current tag/routine.
